image_description: A night-time shot of two illuminated, rectangular street signs mounted on a dark vertical post against a black background. The top sign features blue neon-style lettering that appears to spell 'CALLE' or similar, with a glowing border. The bottom sign is split into two sections: the left side has complex blue neon geometric shapes and partial letters, while the right side features a white glowing panel with a stylized, cartoonish figure (possibly a person or animal) in black outline. The signs exhibit a futuristic, cyberpunk aesthetic rather than standard municipal design. There is visible glow/bloom around the light sources.
